summary: Phase 9F Document Management frontend end-to-end verified. Widget 'Dokumen Akan Kedaluwarsa' renders on Tasks page and Super Admin Dashboard for Super Admin with expected item (PASSPORT · A1234567, Exp 2026-09-06, badge '25d left' in red/amber tone). BookingDetail (BKG-00016) Jamaah tab: PASSPORT upload button opens metadata dialog (doc-meta-dialog) with all fields (doc-meta-number pre-filled 'A1234567', doc-meta-issue, doc-meta-expiry pre-filled 2026-09-06, doc-meta-file, doc-meta-save). KTP upload does NOT open the metadata dialog (quick upload). Jamaah card PASSPORT row shows 'Uploaded', No. A1234567, Exp 2026-09-06 and expiry badge (doc-expiry-<tid>-PASSPORT = '25d left'). Customer 360 documents tab (customer 6a7c6910f21f8ffb9cb4908f) shows the same PASSPORT · A1234567 with '25d left' badge and 'Exp 2026-09-06'. RBAC verified with Sales (Rina Sales): GET /api/documents/expiring?within=90 returns HTTP 200 with [] (owner-scoped, Sales does not own BKG-00016), widget renders empty state (expiring-docs-empty) on both Tasks and Dashboard - no error.

issues: Traveler subtitle still shows 'No passport' even after PASSPORT document has been uploaded with a document_number. The document card below correctly shows 'A1234567', but the traveler-level passport_no field is not synced. Minor cosmetic - not blocking.

action_items: (Minor / optional) Consider syncing traveler.passport_no from uploaded PASSPORT document_number so the traveler card subtitle reflects the number instead of 'No passport'.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpiringDocsWidget correctly gates on RBAC via backend owner-scoping; frontend shows a graceful empty state.
DocMetaDialog is correctly opened only for META_DOC_TYPES (PASSPORT, VISA); other doc types trigger native file input (verified for KTP).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded PASSPORT A1234567 on traveler 6a7c8da00bdc45255f0ea4c4 in booking BKG-00016.
